reusable_lessons.lesson: When comparing groups in exploratory analysis, restrict features to observable claim-level attributes independent of the label. Exclude label-derived fields (e.g., fraud_pattern_type, populated only when fraud_label=1), identifier fields, and protected attributes (sex, race_ethnicity, age_band). This prevents leakage that would compromise statistical validity.

When analyzing synthetic claims data and labels, explicitly disclose the synthetic nature via the synthetic_data caveat in the report. This ensures readers understand the data provenance and that findings cannot be generalized to operational systems.

When producing exploratory fraud analysis, include the no_operational_use caveat to explicitly disclaim that descriptive findings do not support operational fraud detection decisions or real-world deployment.
